name: refactor_csharp_loop_to_linq
description: Refactors an imperative accumulation loop into a single LINQ Where/Sum expression without changing behavior
prompts: Analytics.SumEvenSquares(List<int> nums) in Analytics.cs computes the sum of the squares of the even numbers using an imperative foreach loop with an accumulator. Refactor it into a single LINQ expression (Where to keep the evens, then Sum of each squared). Do not change observable behavior: it returns the same total, and an empty list or a list with no evens returns 0. Keep the class and the SumEvenSquares(List<int>) signature.

setup_files.app.csproj:
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <!-- tests/ has its own project; without this the SDK's default glob
         compiles tests/*.cs into the app itself, where xunit isn't referenced -->
    <Compile Remove="tests/**" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>
